en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānuloma (1), Tikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (1) 1.23.
The Triplet on the Visible and the Impinging (Sanidassanasappaṭighattika)
Section on Analysis:
Root Condition.

Dependent upon a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging, a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging arises by way of the root condition—namely, a non-manifesting and impinging [phenomenon].
Dependent on one great primary element, two great primary elements [arise]; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element [arises].
Dependent on invisible but impinging great primary elements, there arises mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is invisible but impinging.
Dependent on the tangible base, the eye base [arises] …pe… the taste base …pe….
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and impinging, a state that is demonstrable and impinging arises by way of root condition:
dependent on the great elements that are non-demonstrable and impinging, there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that are demonstrable and impinging;
and dependent on the tangible base, the visible base arises.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and impinging, a state that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging arises by way of root condition:
dependent on the great elements that are non-demonstrable and impinging, there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter;
dependent on the tangible base, there arises the water element, the femininity faculty ... pe ... and physical nutriment.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible and impinging, there arise states that are both visible and impinging,
and non-visible and non-impinging, by way of root condition— namely, dependent on the great elements that are non-visible and impinging,
there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter that are both visible and impinging, and non-visible and non-impinging. [This includes] the tangible base.
Dependent on the visible-form base, the water element, a faculty …pe… edible food.
Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging state, there arise states that are both non-manifesting and impinging and non-manifesting and non-impinging by way of root condition—
dependent on one non-manifesting and impinging great primary, two [arise].
The great elements and the water element; and dependent on two great elements and the water element, one great element arises.

Dependent on great elements that are non-manifesting and impinging, there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that are both non-manifesting and impinging, and non-manifesting and non-impinging. Dependent on the tangible base, the eye base arises … [and so on] … the taste base.
The water element, the femininity faculty …pe… edible food.
Dependent on a non-visible, impinging state, both visible-impinging and non-visible-impinging states arise by way of root condition—
dependent on non-visible, impinging great primaries, both visible-impinging and [non-visible-impinging] [derived matter arise].
And invisible-with-resistance derived matter: mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and sustained matter.
Depending on the tangible base, there arise the visible base, the eye base …pe… the taste base.
Depending on a phenomenon that is invisible-with-resistance, there arise phenomena that are both visible-and-resistance and invisible-with-resistance.

And through the condition of cause, there arise phenomena that are non-demonstrable and non-reactive: dependent on great primary elements that are non-demonstrable and reactive, there arises mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is both demonstrable and reactive, non-demonstrable and reactive, and non-demonstrable and non-reactive.
Dependent on the tangible base, there arises the visible base; [dependent on] the eye base...
... pe ... the sense-base of taste, the water element, the femininity faculty ... pe ... edible food.
Dependent on a non-manifesting and non-reactive state (dhamma), a non-manifesting and non-reactive state arises by way of root condition:
dependent on one non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate, three aggregates and the mind-originated matter that is non-manifesting and non-reactive [arise].
... pe ... dependent on two aggregates, [arise] two aggregates and mind-originated matter that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting, [arise] three aggregates and kamma-produced matter that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting ...
pe ... dependent on two aggregates ... pe ... dependent on aggregates, [arises] the physical basis; dependent on the physical basis, [arise] the aggregates.
Dependent on the water element, there arises invisible and non-resistant matter consisting of mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter.
Dependent on the water element, there arises the female faculty ... [and so on] ... edible food.
Dependent on an invisible and non-resistant state, a visible and resistant state arises by way of root condition—dependent on an invisible and non-resistant [state].

Dependent on the aggregates, there is mind-originated matter that is visible and impinging. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the invisible and non-impinging aggregates, there is kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging.

Dependent on the water element, there is mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter that are visible and impinging. Dependent on the water element, there is the visible base (rūpāyatana).
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state that is non-demonstrable and reactive arises by way of root condition:

dependent on non-demonstrable and non-reactive aggregates, there arises mind-originated matter that is non-demonstrable and reactive; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-demonstrable and non-reactive aggregates, there arises kamma-produced matter that is non-demonstrable and reactive;
dependent on the water element, [there arises matter] that is non-demonstrable and reactive.
Mind-produced matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter. Dependent on the water element, there arises the eye-base …pe… the taste-base.

Dependent on a non-manifesting and non-reactive state, both manifesting-and-reactive and non-manifesting-and-non-reactive states arise by way of root condition—dependent on one non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate, [there arise] three [aggregates].

The aggregates that are both visible and impinging, and the mind-originated matter that is invisible and non-impinging …pe… [dependent on] two aggregates …pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate that is invisible and non-impinging, arise three aggregates;
[dependent on] the kamma-produced matter that is both visible and impinging, and the invisible and non-impinging [matter] …pe… dependent on two aggregates …pe….
...pe... dependent on the water element, there is mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is both visible and impinging, as well as invisible and non-impinging.
Dependent on the water element, there is the visible base, the femininity faculty ...pe... and edible food.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is invisible and non-impinging, there is [matter] that is invisible and impinging, and [matter] that is invisible and non-impinging.
And states arise by way of root condition: dependent on one invisible and non-reacting aggregate,

there arise three aggregates and invisible-non-reacting mind-originated matter …pe… [dependent on] two aggregates …pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one invisible and non-reacting aggregate, there arise three [aggregates].
The aggregates that are non-demonstrable and impinging, and those that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging;

kamma-produced matter …pe… [dependent on] two aggregates …pe… dependent on the water element, there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter that are non-demonstrable and impinging, and non-demonstrable and non-impinging. Dependent on the water element, there arises the eye-base …pe… the taste-base.
The femininity faculty … [and so on] … edible food.
Dependent upon a non-manifesting and non-reactive state, both manifest-and-reactive and non-manifesting-but-reactive states arise by way of root condition—
dependent upon non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregates, both manifest-and-reactive and non-manifesting-but-reactive [states arise].

And mind-originated matter that is non-demonstrable and impinging. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging, there is kamma-produced matter that is both demonstrable and impinging, and non-demonstrable and impinging.
Dependent on the water element, there is mind-originated matter and kamma-produced matter that are both demonstrable and impinging, and non-demonstrable and impinging.
Derived form. Depending on the water element, there arise the visible base, the eye base …pe… the taste base.

Depending on a non-manifesting and non-reactive state, there arise states that are both manifesting and reactive, non-manifesting but reactive, and non-manifesting and non-reactive by way of root condition—namely, one non-manifesting and non-reactive [state].
Dependent on one aggregate, there arise three aggregates— visible-with-resistance, invisible-with-resistance,
and invisible-without-resistance— as well as mind-originated matter …pe… [dependent on] two aggregates …pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking,
dependent on one invisible-without-resistance aggregate, there arise three aggregates— visible-with-resistance and invisible-with-resistance.

... non-demonstrable and non-reactive matter produced by karma ... [and so on] ... two aggregates ... [and so on] ... dependent on the water element, there arises mind-originated matter, matter produced by karma, and derived matter that is both demonstrable and reactive, non-demonstrable and reactive, and non-demonstrable and non-reactive.
Dependent on the water element, there arises the visible-form base, the eye base ... [and so on] ... the taste base, the femininity faculty.
…pe… edible food.
Dependent on phenomena that are non-manifesting-and-reacting and non-manifesting-non-reacting,
a phenomenon that is manifesting-and-reacting arises by way of root condition— dependent on non-manifesting-non-reacting aggregates and the great elements.

Visible and impinging matter originated by mind. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-visible and non-impinging aggregates and the great primaries, there is kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging.
Dependent on non-visible but impinging great primaries and the water element, there is visible and impinging matter originated by mind and kamma-produced matter.
Derived form. The visible-form base arises dependent on the tangible-base element and the water element.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging, as well as a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and non-impinging, a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging arises by way of root condition—dependent on aggregates that are non-manifesting and non-impinging and the great primary elements.

Non-demonstrable and impinging matter originated by mind. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-demonstrable and non-impinging aggregates and the great primary elements, there is non-demonstrable and impinging matter produced by kamma.
Dependent on one non-demonstrable and impinging great primary element and the water element, there are two great primary elements; and dependent on two great primary elements and the water element...

Dependent on one great primary element; dependent on invisible but impinging great primaries and the water element, there arises mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is invisible and impinging.
Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, there arises the eye base … [and so on] … the taste base.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and impinging, or a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging, a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging arises by way of root condition: dependent on non-demonstrable and non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, there arises mind-originated matter that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging.
At the moment of rebirth-linking, [dependent on] non-demonstrable and non-impinging...
Dependent on the aggregates and the great primary elements, there is invisible and non-reacting matter consisting of what has been produced (kaṭattārūpa).
Dependent on invisible but reacting great primary elements and the water element, there is invisible and non-reacting matter that is mind-originated, produced, and derived.
Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, there is the female faculty … [and so on] … edible food.

Dependent on phenomena that are non-demonstrable and impinging, as well as phenomena that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging, there arise phenomena that are demonstrable and impinging, as well as phenomena that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*):

dependent on aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging, and the great primary elements (*mahābhūta*), there arises mind-originated matter that is both demonstrable and impinging, as well as non-demonstrable and non-impinging.

Form: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on invisible and non-reacting aggregates and great primaries, there arises kamma-produced form that is both visible-and-reacting and invisible-and-non-reacting.
Dependent on invisible-but-reacting great primaries and the water element, there arises mind-originated and kamma-produced form that is both visible-and-reacting and invisible-and-non-reacting.
Derived matter. Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, there arises the visible base, the femininity faculty … [and so on] … and physical nutriment.

Dependent on states that are non-manifesting and impinging and non-manifesting and non-impinging, there arise states that are non-manifesting and impinging and non-manifesting and non-impinging by way of root condition: [namely,] the aggregates that are non-manifesting and non-impinging.
And dependent on great primaries that are non-demonstrable and impinging, there arises mind-originated matter that is both non-demonstrable and impinging and non-demonstrable and non-impinging.

At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging and on great primaries, there arises kamma-produced matter that is both non-demonstrable and impinging and non-demonstrable and non-impinging.
And dependent on great primaries that are non-demonstrable and impinging and on the water element...
Dependent on the invisible-with-resistance and the invisible-without-resistance, there arise mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter.
Dependent on the tangible base and the water element, there arises the eye base …pe… the taste base,
the femininity faculty …pe… and physical nutriment.

Dependent on phenomena that are non-demonstrable and impinging, and phenomena that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging, there arise phenomena that are demonstrable and impinging, and phenomena that are non-demonstrable and impinging, by way of root condition—

dependent on aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-impinging and the great elements, there arises mind-originated matter that is both demonstrable and impinging and non-demonstrable and impinging.

Form: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on invisible and non-reacting aggregates and great primaries, there arises kamma-produced form that is both visible and reacting, as well as invisible but reacting;

and dependent on invisible and reacting great primaries and the water element, there arises mind-originated form and kamma-produced form that are both visible and reacting, as well as invisible but reacting.
Derived matter. Depending on the tangible base and the water element, there arise the visible base, the eye base, ... [and so on] ... the taste base.

Depending on states that are non-visible and impinging, as well as non-visible and non-impinging, there arise states that are both visible and impinging, non-visible and impinging, and non-visible and non-impinging, by way of root condition—[depending on] those that are non-visible and non-impinging.
Dependent on aggregates and great elements, there arises mind-originated matter that is both visible and impinging,
invisible and impinging, and invisible and non-impinging. At the moment of rebirth-linking,
dependent on aggregates and great elements that are invisible and non-impinging, there arise [matter] that is both visible and impinging and invisible and impinging.

And derived matter consisting of the kamma-born (kaṭattārūpa) that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting. Depending on the great elements (mahābhūta) that are non-demonstrable and reacting, and on the water element (āpodhātu), there arises mind-originated matter (cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa), kamma-born matter, and derived matter (upādārūpa) that is demonstrable and reacting, non-demonstrable and reacting, and non-demonstrable and non-reacting.
And depending on the tangible base (phoṭṭhabbāyatana) and the water element, there arises the visible base (rūpāyatana).
The eye-base …pe… the taste-base; the femininity-faculty …pe… edible food.
Dependent on a non-manifesting and non-reactive state, a non-manifesting and non-reactive state arises by way of object-condition—[dependent on] a non-manifesting and non-reactive [state].
Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates arise … two aggregates … At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate,
three aggregates arise … two aggregates … dependent on the [heart-]base, the aggregates arise.
(Predominance condition)
Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging state, a non-manifesting and impinging state arises by way of predominance condition:
dependent on one non-manifesting and impinging great primary element, two great primary elements arise; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element arises;
and dependent on non-manifesting and impinging great primary elements, mind-originated derived matter arises.
(Regarding the section based on the non-demonstrable and impinging, seven questions are to be analyzed by this same method; there are no concluding terms.
Dependent on a non-demonstrable and non-impinging state, a non-demonstrable and non-impinging state arises by way of predominance condition:
dependent on one non-demonstrable and non-impinging aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated matter arise which are non-demonstrable and non-impinging.
... pe ... two aggregates ... pe ... dependent on the water element, there is invisible and non-reacting matter derived from mind-produced matter.
(By this method, seven questions based on the invisible and non-reacting should be analyzed; there are no concluding phrases.
Dependent on a state that is both invisible and with resistance, and invisible and without resistance, [arises] a state that is visible and with resistance.
A phenomenon arises by way of predominance condition: dependent on non-visible and non-reacting aggregates and great primaries, there arises mind-originated matter that is visible and reacting;
and dependent on non-visible and non-reacting great primaries and the water element, there arises mind-originated derived matter that is visible and reacting.
For this reason, even the seven questions should be analyzed as follows:

"Dependent on a non-visible and non-reactive state, a non-visible and non-reactive state arises by way of proximity condition... by way of contiguity condition. (The same as for the object condition.)
Dependent on a state that is co-nascent, non-manifest, and impinging, there arises a state that is co-nascent, non-manifest, and impinging, by way of co-nascence condition:

dependent on one great primary element that is non-manifest and impinging, two great primary elements arise; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element arises. [In the case] of those that are non-manifest and impinging...
Dependent on great primaries, there arises mind-produced matter that is non-demonstrable and impinging, kamma-born matter, and derived matter.
Dependent on the tangible base, there arises the eye base …pe… the taste base.
External … nutriment-produced … temperature-produced … dependent on one great primary of non-percipient beings, there arise two great primaries …pe….
(The seven questions based on the non-indicative-with-resistance [anidassanasappaṭigha] root should be analyzed by this same method.
Dependent on a non-indicative-and-non-resistant phenomenon, a non-indicative-and-non-resistant phenomenon arises by way of co-nascence condition:
dependent on one non-indicative-and-non-resistant aggregate, three aggregates and non-indicative-and-non-resistant mind-originated matter arise.

... pe ... dependent on two aggregates ... pe ... at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-manifest and non-reactive aggregate, there are three aggregates and non-manifest matter produced by past action (kaṭattā-rūpa) ... pe ... dependent on two aggregates ... pe ...
dependent on the aggregates, there is the [heart-]base; dependent on the base, there are the aggregates. Dependent on the water element, there is non-manifest and non-reactive mind-originated matter.
Form consists of kamma-produced form and derived form. Depending on the water element, there is the female faculty … [and so on] … edible food.

External … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … and, in the case of non-percipient beings, depending on the water element, there is invisible and non-reacting kamma-produced form and derived form.
(Seven questions based on the non-demonstrable and non-reactive [anidassana-appaṭigha] root should be formulated by this same method:
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and reactive and a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive,
a phenomenon that is demonstrable and reactive arises by way of co-nascence condition— dependent on the aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-reactive and the great elements.

Visible and impinging matter originated by mind. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-visible and non-impinging aggregates and great primaries, there is kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging.
Dependent on non-visible but impinging great primaries and the water element, there is visible and impinging matter originated by mind and kamma-produced matter.
Derived form: the visible-form base dependent on the tangible-base element and the water element; external ... nutriment-produced ...

temperature-produced ... and the derived form consisting of kamma-born matter that is both visible and impinging, dependent on the great primary elements that are non-manifesting but impinging and the water element of non-percipient beings.
For this reason, seven questions are to be analyzed.

Regarding mutual conditionality: in dependence upon a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon, a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon arises by way of mutual condition—[namely] a non-manifesting and impinging...
Dependent on one great primary element (mahābhūta), two great primary elements [arise]; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element [arises].

Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon, a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon arises by way of mutuality condition: dependent on the non-manifesting and impinging great primary elements, the water element [arises].
Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon, both a non-manifesting and impinging phenomenon and a non-manifesting and non-impinging phenomenon [arise]...
And phenomena arise through mutual conditionality: depending on one great primary element that is non-demonstrable and impinging, two great primary elements and the water element arise;
depending on two great primary elements, one great primary element and the water element arise. External...

[and so forth] ...Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging, a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-impinging arises through mutual conditionality: [depending on] a non-demonstrable and non-impinging...
Dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates arise … two aggregates … At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate,
three aggregates and the [heart-]base arise … two aggregates … dependent on the aggregates,
the base arises; dependent on the base, the aggregates arise.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting, a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and reacting arises by way of mutuality condition: dependent on the water element, the great primaries that are non-demonstrable and reacting [arise].

[The same applies to] external [phenomena]…pe… Dependent on a phenomenon that is both non-demonstrable and reacting and a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting, a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and reacting arises by way of mutuality condition:
[dependent on] one great primary that is non-demonstrable and reacting and the water element…pe…
Dependent on two great elements, and dependent on two great elements and the water element, one great element [arises]. External ...
[and so forth] ...
Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging state, a non-manifesting and impinging state arises by way of the dependence condition (nissaya-paccaya).

… by way of decisive support condition … by way of prenascence condition … by way of repetition condition … by way of kamma condition … by way of result condition … by way of nutriment condition … by way of faculty condition … by way of jhāna condition … by way of path condition … by way of association condition … by way of dissociation condition … by way of presence condition … by way of absence condition … by way of disappearance condition … by way of non-disappearance condition.

In the Pure Cause Enumeration: twenty-one in the cause condition, one in the object condition, twenty-one in the predominance condition, one in the proximity condition, and one in the contiguity condition.
In co-nascence there are twenty-one; in mutuality, six; in dependence, twenty-one; in strong-dependence, one;
in prenascence, one; in repetition, one; in kamma, twenty-one; in resultant, nutriment, and faculty, twenty-one each; in jhāna, path, and association, twenty-one each;
in dissociation, twenty-one; in presence, twenty-one; in absence, one; in disappearance, one.
In the unobscured, twenty-one. (Thus it should be counted.
The Positive Order.
1.23.1.2. The Negative Order of Conditions.
Section on Analysis: Not-root Condition.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging, there arises a phenomenon that is non-manifesting and impinging by way of the not-root condition—[namely,] a non-manifesting and impinging [phenomenon].
Dependent on one great primary element, two great primary elements [arise]; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element [arises].
Dependent on invisible but impinging great primary elements, there arises mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is invisible but impinging.
Dependent on the tangible base, there arises the eye base … the taste base. External … nutriment-originated.
… arisen from temperature … for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great primary element that is non-demonstrable and impinging, there are two great primary elements;
dependent on two great primary elements, there is one great primary element;
dependent on [all] great primary elements … (By this method, all seven questions based on the "non-demonstrable and impinging" category should be analyzed.)
Dependent on a non-manifesting and non-reactive state, a non-manifesting and non-reactive state arises by way of the not-root condition:

dependent on one rootless non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise … [and so on] … dependent on two aggregates … [and so on] … at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one non-manifesting and non-reactive aggregate … [and so on].

Dependent on [one] aggregate, there arise three aggregates, non-demonstrable and non-reacting derived matter, and matter produced by karma …pe… dependent on the aggregates, there arises the [heart-]base;

dependent on the base, there arise the aggregates. Dependent on the water element, there arises non-demonstrable and non-reacting matter originating from mind, matter produced by karma, and derived matter. Dependent on the water element, there arises the female faculty …pe… edible food.

External ... nutriment-originated ... temperature-originated ... and, in the case of non-percipient beings, dependent on the water element, [there arises] derived matter consisting of kamma-born matter that is non-demonstrable and non-reacting.
Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, there arises delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness.
(For this reason, seven questions should be analyzed based on the non-demonstrable and non-reactive [anidassana-appaṭigha] roots:

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and with-reaction and a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a phenomenon that is demonstrable and with-reaction arises by way of the not-root condition (*na-hetu-paccaya*): [namely,] dependent on rootless aggregates that are non-demonstrable and non-reactive and the great elements (*mahābhūta*).

Dependent on [the four great elements], there is mind-originated matter that is visible and impinging. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on the invisible and non-impinging aggregates and the great elements, there is kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging.
Dependent on the invisible and impinging great elements and the water element, there is mind-originated matter and kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging.
Derived matter: the visible-object base dependent on the tangible-object base and the water element; external [matter]; matter produced by nutriment;
matter produced by temperature; and the visible, impinging kamma-born derived matter dependent on the non-visible, impinging great primaries and the water element of non-percipient beings.
(For this reason, the seven questions should be expanded upon without confusion:
Dependent on a non-manifesting and impinging state, a non-manifesting and impinging state arises by way of the not-object condition— a non-manifesting and impinging...
Dependent on one great primary element, two great primary elements [arise]; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element [arises].
Dependent on invisible but impinging great primary elements, there arises mind-originated matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter that is invisible and impinging.
Dependent on the tangible base, there arises the eye base …pe… the taste base. External … nutriment-originated … [and so forth].
… originating from nutriment … for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great primary element that is non-demonstrable and impinging,
two great primary elements [arise]; dependent on two great primary elements, one great primary element [arises] … (By this method,
all seven questions based on the non-demonstrable and impinging should be expanded in detail.)
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive arises by way of not-object condition:

dependent on non-demonstrable and non-reactive aggregates, there arises mind-produced matter that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on non-demonstrable and non-reactive aggregates, there arises kamma-produced matter that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive;
dependent on the aggregates, there is the [heart-]base …pe… dependent on the water element.
Dependent on the water element, there is invisible and non-reacting matter derived from mind, matter due to kamma performed (kaṭattā-rūpa), and derived matter.
Dependent on the water element, there is the female faculty … [and so on] … edible food.

External … matter produced by food … matter produced by temperature … dependent on the water element of non-percipient beings, there is invisible and non-reacting matter due to kamma performed and derived matter.
(For this reason, all seven questions in the "Non-indicative and Non-reactive" base should be expanded.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-indicative and with-reaction, and a phenomenon that is non-indicative and non-reactive, there arises a phenomenon that is indicative and with-reaction by way of not-object condition: dependent on the non-indicative and non-reactive aggregates and the great elements.

Visible and impinging matter originated by mind; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on invisible and non-impinging aggregates and the great primaries, there is kamma-produced matter that is visible and impinging;
